reasoning: This repository is an end-to-end benchmarking and experiment-orchestration tool for llm-d inference stacks. It provides a Python CLI that renders Kubernetes manifests, provisions and validates deployments, runs benchmark workloads, collects and analyzes results, and tears resources down. Although it is packaged as a Python library, its primary architectural role is a lifecycle automation/benchmarking utility rather than a reusable library. It does not present as an operator with reconciliation logic or CRDs, a continuously running inference service, or configuration-only content, so it is best classified as other.
